report.executive_thesis:
DIRECT INQUIRY RESOLUTION:
TCS.NS is currently rated as an ACCUMULATE_STAGGERED opportunity. Over a 3-year investment horizon, your initial capital of ₹1,000,000 is projected to reach a median gross value of ₹1,456,641. This represents a 13.36% CAGR. The asset demonstrates a robust probability of 77.9% to outperform the 5.49% inflation benchmark, positioning it as a reliable vehicle for wealth compounding despite current market volatility.

PORTFOLIO CONVICTION & POSTURE:
The conviction score of 84/100 reflects high confidence in the underlying business model, tempered by the necessity of a staggered entry strategy. ACCUMULATE_STAGGERED is the recommended posture to mitigate the impact of short-term price fluctuations. For your fresh deployment of ₹1,000,000, you should avoid lump-sum entry to prevent timing risk, instead opting for a systematic deployment schedule to lower your average cost basis during periods of market correction.

QUANTITATIVE VOLATILITY & DOWNSIDE VAR:
The 1-Year 95% Parametric VaR of -13.3% indicates that in a 1-in-20 year event, your position could see a temporary decline of this magnitude. The 95% Conditional VaR of -20.2% accounts for tail-risk scenarios. The 3-Year Bearish Floor (P10) at ₹2,488.55 highlights a scenario where cyclical stagnation and high volatility diffusion drag effectively neutralize the expected drift. While the P50 median target of ₹3,605.77 represents the most probable outcome, the P10 floor serves as a stress-test boundary, suggesting that in a severe 3-year downcycle, the asset may struggle to provide significant real returns, though it remains resilient against total capital erosion.

STRUCTURAL CATALYSTS & VALUATION:
TCS.NS maintains a strong competitive moat driven by consistent operating cash flows and high return on equity (ROE). The valuation is supported by the company's ability to scale digital transformation services and maintain margins despite global macroeconomic headwinds. DCF drivers remain anchored by stable free cash flow generation and a disciplined capital allocation policy, which provides a fundamental buffer against the volatility metrics noted above.

STATUTORY TAX DRAG & NET IN-HAND WEALTH:
Applying the Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, your gross final wealth of ₹1,456,641 is subject to a 12.5% LTCG tax on gains exceeding the ₹1.25 Lakh threshold, alongside a 0.1% delivery STT. After accounting for these statutory obligations, your net post-tax realized wealth is approximately ₹1,408,000, resulting in a net post-tax CAGR of 12.19%.

PERSONALIZED ACTION BLUEPRINT:
To achieve your wealth compounding objective with your ₹1,000,000 fresh capital, follow this deployment framework:
• Phase 1: Deploy 30% of your capital immediately to establish a core position.
• Phase 2: Allocate the remaining 70% into four equal tranches of ₹175,000 each.
• Phase 3: Execute these tranches at 3-month intervals or upon a 5% decline from your initial entry price, whichever occurs first.
• Phase 4: Maintain the position for the full 3-year horizon to allow the compounding effect to overcome the initial tax drag and volatility-induced friction.
• Monitoring: Review the position semi-annually to ensure the fundamental thesis remains intact, focusing on operating margin stability rather than short-term price variance.

PERSONALIZED PORTFOLIO GUIDANCE:
For 10-year wealth compounding, your ₹1,000,000 investment is modeled to compound into ₹1,456,641 (Base P50 target). Maintain full conviction hold. Rebalance only if asset drifts beyond ±5% of your strategic asset allocation.

retrieved_evidence.title: Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) Equity Delivery
retrieved_evidence.sanitized_snippet:
<UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT id="FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DELIVERY" authority="Ministry of Finance, Government of India">
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) Equity Delivery
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, Chapter VII — Securities Transaction Tax: Under Section 98 and Section 99, taxable securities transactions in Equity Delivery on recognized stock exchanges shall be levied at 0.1% (one-tenth of one percent) payable by both the purchaser and seller. For equity intraday (non-delivery) transactions, the statutory rate is 0.025% payable by the seller only. Statutory costs are mandatory and deduct from gross trading turnover before net trading realization.
</UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT>
